item_title: Interviews with more than 24 people involved in the AT&T/Time Warner merger, including Jeff Bewkes and Randall Stephenson, detail how it went disastrously awry
item_description: James B. Stewart / New York Times:  — At Time Warner, executives saw AT&T as just a “big phone company from Texas.” At AT&T, they thought Hollywood would play by their rules.

item_title: Blackstone to acquire a 52% stake in R Systems, a publicly traded Indian IT services company, for $359M
item_description: Reuters: Blackstone to acquire a 52% stake in R Systems, a publicly traded Indian IT services company, for $359M — U.S. investment fund Blackstone Inc (BX.N) said on Thursday it would buy a 52% stake in India's R Systems International (RSYS.NS) from the IT services company's promoters for $359 million.

item_title: Twitter reinstates Trump's account, after Elon Musk ran a Twitter poll where 51.8% of 15M+ users voted yes to reinstatement, saying “the people have spoken”
item_description: Reuters: Twitter reinstates Trump's account, after Elon Musk ran a Twitter poll where 51.8% of 15M+ users voted yes to reinstatement, saying “the people have spoken” — Donald Trump on Saturday said he had no interest in returning to Twitter even as a slim majority voted in favor …

item_title: Wickr Me, the free encrypted messaging app acquired by AWS in 2021, will shut down on December 31, 2023 and stop accepting new users at the end of 2022
item_description: Emma Roth / The Verge:  — Wickr Me, the free encrypted messaging app owned by Amazon Web Services, is shutting down on December 31st, 2023.

item_title: As climate change threatens data centers, Amazon, Microsoft, and Google are tinkering with cooling options and building data centers in colder countries
item_description: David Lumb / CNET:  — Data centers run our personal and professional lives, so it's crucial that they keep working in a future of climate change.

item_title: Ripple says it is effectively “operating outside of the US” due to its legal fight with the SEC and is seeking a license in Ireland to drive EU expansion
item_description: Ryan Browne / CNBC:  — - Ripple is expanding its presence in the EU, where it plans to “passport” its services through an entity in Ireland, General Counsel Stuart Alderoty told CNBC.

item_title: Elon Musk is running a Twitter poll on reinstating Trump, after saying in October that Twitter plans a “content moderation council” to make such decisions
item_description: Herb Scribner / Axios:  — Elon Musk dropped a 24-hour poll on his own Twitter feed Friday night asking whether or not to reinstate former President Trump to the social media platform.

item_title: A look at South Korean conglomerate Naver's experiments with a fleet of ~100 office robots, including efforts to make employees comfortable with their presence
item_description: New York Times:  — Naver, a South Korean internet firm, is trying to introduce robots into the world of cubicles and conference rooms without making employees uncomfortable.
